task.title: Creating a user account by using the Red Hat Quay API
task.shortdesc: To create a user account in Red Hat Quay as a superuser, you can use the Red Hat Quay API.

ul.li: You are logged into your Red Hat Quay deployment as a superuser.
You have created an OAuth access token.

step.cmd: Enter the following command to create a new user by using the POST /api/v1/superuser/users/ endpoint:

Navigate to your Red Hat Quay registry endpoint, for example, quay-server.example.com and log in with the username and password generated from the API call. In this scenario, the username is newuser and the password is 123456789. Alternatively, you can log in to the registry with the CLI. For example:
Optional. You can obtain a list of all users, including superusers, by using the GET /api/v1/superuser/users/ endpoint:

note.p: The GET /api/v1/superuser/users/ endpoint only returns users and superusers if AUTHENTICATION_TYPE: Database is set in your config.yaml file. It does not work for LDAP authentication types.
